verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird ships client-facing legaltech tools such as the SCC Generator and the Term Sheet Generator, so asking about a public API is a fair question. But the evidence shows these are interactive questionnaires built on Contract Express, with no documented public API. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, and the Docusign integration is an adjacent feature, not an API a user can drive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
